text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Cabinet meeting chaired by President Ben Ali discusses measures to support exports sector. Further discussions were planned.
- Spanish Foreign Affairs Minister Matutes to start three-day official visit to Tunis on Thursday.
- Belgian group Tractebel ready to invest in Tunisian power plant.
- Tunisian native Serge Adda named chairman of France's Canal Horizons television.
- Sfax International Fair opens with participation of 136 foreign firms.
- Kuwaiti scholars visiting Tunisia this week.
